project_description: Complete the billing architecture convergence after billing-post-usage-correctness-hardening: rate directly from BillingCallID-scoped call/leg usage records, delete legacy TUR/LUR and reserved-balance production architecture, remove money-capable duplicate UsageAuthority paths, decouple provider COGS from customer account serialization, replace synchronous central terminal append plus retry layering with one process-local durable spool, and enforce a materially smaller single monetary architecture.
